name: com.jonghyunkim.nativetoolkit
description: Toolkit for Unity 6+ providing native dialog, notification, share, and clipboard APIs (Android/iOS/Windows/macOS), sample content, a build step that adds the Android libraries and their Gradle dependencies, iOS libraries that Unity links and embeds by itself, and an editor workflow to add the native library to macOS Xcode projects.

samples.description: A sample showcasing native toolkit functionalities.
